description:
The perfect being of Yesung High School, Yesung High School angel Song Ye-na! In fact, Ye-na has a violent personality contrary to her perfect appearance, and she relieves stress by acting perfect at school through her escape game. During her seemingly smooth school life, she feels a sense of crisis when Baek Seung-jin begins to doubt her...! A gag romance & youth growth drama about Ye-na, who acts perfect even though she is not perfect, and Seung-jin, who believes that being true even if it is not perfect is important.

**Original Webtoon:**
